mapper.select: select p.code, rp.data_scope from role_permission rp inner join `role` r on r.id = rp.role_id inner join permission p on p.id = rp.permission_id where rp.role_id = #{roleId} and r.status = 'ACTIVE' order by p.code

select rp.id, rp.role_id, rp.permission_id, rp.data_scope, rp.version, rp.created_at, rp.updated_at from role_permission rp inner join `role` r on r.id = rp.role_id inner join permission p on p.id = rp.permission_id where rp.role_id = #{roleId} and r.status = 'ACTIVE' and p.code = #{permissionCode}
